newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins rise as market awaits rating soon.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins rise as market awaits rating soon.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds rose on Tuesday on speculation Russia could get a BB plus rating this week, dealers said.
Emerging market traders cited rumours on Tuesday European rating agency IBCA might announce a BB plus level for Russia this week.

"All Russia's debt has gone up, and the (rating) news is the only reason. Some banks are taking profits, but demand is so big that all tranches are higher than in the morning," Mosbiznesbank dealer Igor Potapov said.
Dealers said prices were likely to firm further as active buying is continuing on the Western side as trading inside Russia had almost stopped until Wednesday.

"The market is very strong and client demand seems the main reason," a London bank dealer said, adding that MinFins were following the Vnesh debt rally, with some operators buying bonds to hedge their Vnesh debt positions.
